_comment: Tier-2 for sparta (all physics): every generator the catalog advertises is generated, validated, data-staged and RUN on the installed binary — 12 variants across 10 physics rows, all rc=0. Also gates payload hygiene: get_knowledge() must contain no absolute host path (the old 'installed_build' block hard-coded four) and every pitfall must carry a Signal: clause. The binary part skips cleanly when SPARTA is absent; the hygiene part always runs. KEY DRIFT FIXED 2026-08-06: this fixture was keyed pitfall_index 9, which on rarefied_flow is the universal [Setup] claim that 'global nrho ... fnum ...' must precede create_particles — a claim it never touches. So that claim read as covered while the evidence pointed at a catalog smoke test, the same defect found in three of FEBio's six pre-existing fixtures. The index is now SYNTHETIC (past the end of every pitfall list) and 'covers' is explicitly empty: this fixture is a catalog gate, not evidence for a pitfall. The nrho-ordering claim now has its own fixture, global_nrho_before_create_particles.
